The '''Battle of Cularin''' was fought in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], near to the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] that resulted in the demise of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] ''[[Shadowblade]]''.

==Prelude==
Following the declaration of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], an order that called for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to kill their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] commanders, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] prevented the [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] who served under him from learning about the order, by disabling the long-range communications aboard his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Maelstrom (Maelstrom-class)/Legends|''Maelstrom'']]. The ''Maelstrom'' arrived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and there, its sensors revealed that two [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], the ''[[Primal]]'' and the [[Undaunted (Republic cruiser)|''Undaunted'']], were firing on Jedi starships that were fleeing the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. Jeht told his crew that the two [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] had been taken over by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and planned to attack them, using the ''Maelstrom''.

==The battle==
===Jeht's deceit===
Jeht sent a short-range signal to the ''Primal'' and the ''Undaunted'', informing them that the ''Maelstrom'' had been ordered to hunt down targets in the inner regions of the Cularin system. The two ships parted to let Jeht's ship pass and when it was between them, it opened fire. The two gunships were taken by surprise and the ''Undaunted'' began to leak [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] from its engine decks, and listed to the side. The ''Primal'' was less damaged, but still had it's weapons arrays brought offline.

The Jedi Master ordered [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to launch from the ''Maelstrom''. His [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R-0]], began broadcasting false CIS binary control signals in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the ship, leading Jeht's clone troops to believe that the starfighters from the ''Primal'' and ''Undaunted'' were being controlled by [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. The clones then detected that the ''Maelstrom'' was the source of the signals and came to the conclusion that the Confederacy was trying to take control of the [[Warship/Legends|warship's]] control system. Jeht ordered them to lock out all external communications and to bring down the primary communications array, supposedly to stop the CIS signals.

The ''Maelstrom'' took a hit on it's starboard side, then turned around and fired on the ''Undaunted'', causing the stricken vessel to explode. The ''Primal'' had brought it's weapons back online and fired on the ''Maelstrom'', causing damage to its port main thruster. Jeht told his crew to turn off the ''Maelstrom''{{'s}} engines and overburn the vessel's bow thrusters, even though the thrusters were not designed for use in the space. The effect of this was to flip the ''Maelstrom'' over while propelling it forward, and it took the crew of the ''Primal'' by surprise. The ''Maelstrom'' fired all of its forward guns and the ''Primal'' exploded.

===The arrival of the ''Shadowblade''===
With the battle seemingly won, Jeht planned to leave in his starship, the [[Legacy (Darrus Jeht)|''Legacy'']], before the clones learned Order 66. However, his plans were interupted by the arrival of the ''[[Shadowblade]]'', a Separatist [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] that Jeht had believed to have been destroyed. The Separatist vessel was on a course towards the planet [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], the system's primary world and Jeht determined to stop it. However, the ''Maelstrom'' was unable to fire it's main guns, because their cores had been shattered by firing just after the ship's reversal. With no other option left, Jeht decided to attempt to destroy the ''Shadowblade'' by ramming it with the ''Maelstrom'', in a suicide attack.

The ''Shadowblade'' headed through the [[Cularin asteroid belt]] en route to Cularin. To try and catch up with it, Jeht brought the ''Maelstrom'' through some secret, [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]]-free routes through the belt, details of which had been given to him years earlier, by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]]. He also told R-0 and [[Milinae Untaire]] to leave the ''Maelstrom'' and flee aboard the ''Legacy''.

When the ''Shadowblade'' emerged from the asteroid belt, the ''Maelstrom''{{'s}} crew lost their sensor lock on it, due to the presence of [[Time/Legends|time]] rifts, which were left over from when the [[Darkstaff]] had caused the Cularin system to [[Cularin's disappearance|disappear]] from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for ten years. Jeht ordered his crew to fire [[Torpedo/Legends|torpedos]] at the ''Shadowblade'', even though they had little chance of penetrating the CIS ship's [[Energy shielding|shields]], or being targeted effectively, due to the ''Shadowblade''s [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking device]].

None of the torpedos caused any damage to the ''Shadowblade'', but they alerted it to the presence of the ''Maelstrom'', so the superweapon changed course, to intercept the Republic warship. Jeht wanted to lure the ''Shadowblade'' towards the ''Maelstrom'', so that he could cause it to pass through one of the time rifts, preventing it from attacking Cularin. The ''Shadowblade'' opened fire and caused severe damage to the ''Maelstrom'' with it's first volley. It then fired a second volley, causing seven of the ''Maelstrom''{{'s}} decks to vent out into space. However, the ''Maelstrom'' then activated it's [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] and pulled the CIS vessel towards a time rift. Both ships plumetted through the rift and disappeared.
